integrity: A symbolic prefix-potential proof and explicit sharp witnesses are included; independent checks are finite corroborations, not a substitute for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to binary Dyck words, fixed two-letter scattered-subsequence universality and maximum nesting height. No uniqueness of extremizers or multivariate generating function established. Independently unverified.
title: Sharp nesting-depth tradeoff for subsequence universality of Dyck words
